title: Informative Local Average Treatment Effects Using Propensity Scores
abstract: arXiv:2611.25253v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In instrumental variable (IV) models, comparisons of conditional local average treatment effects across covariates can mix effect heterogeneity in observed covariates with changes in the complier population, that is, those whose treatment responds to the instrument. Compliers at different covariate values may differ in unobserved characteristics that may also drive effect heterogeneity. We propose informative conditional local average treatment effects (ICLATEs), which condition on a subset of covariates of interest and on the treatment propensity scores under both values of a binary instrument. Fixing these scores holds constant the range of unobservables that drive treatment selection and thus compliance, while the composition of the covariates not conditioned on may change. translated_title: 基于倾向得分的信息性局部平均处理效应
translated_abstract: 在工具变量（IV）模型中，跨协变量比较条件局部平均处理效应时，会把可观测协变量上的效应异质性与依从者群体（即处理状态随工具变量变化的个体）的变化混杂在一起；不同协变量取值下的依从者在未观测特征上可能存在差异，而这些未观测特征同样可能驱动效应异质性。我们提出了信息性条件局部平均处理效应（ICLATEs），其以感兴趣的协变量子集以及二元工具变量在两个取值下的处理倾向得分为条件。固定这些倾向得分可以保持驱动处理选择进而驱动依从性的不可观测变量范围不变，而未被条件化的协变量构成则可以发生变化。在条件工具变量假设和适当的支撑条件下，我们建立了非参数识别，并刻画了ICLATEs与边际效应之间的关系。
tldr: 该论文提出信息性条件局部平均处理效应（ICLATEs），通过同时以感兴趣的协变量和二元工具变量两个取值下的处理倾向得分为条件来固定驱动依从性的不可观测变量范围，从而在工具变量模型中实现不混杂依从者群体变化的效应异质性识别与比较。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes informative conditional local average treatment effects (ICLATEs), which condition on both covariates of interest and the treatment propensity scores under both values of a binary instrument, thereby holding fixed the range of unobservables driving compliance and enabling nonparametric identification of effect heterogeneity without conflating changes in the complier population.
